record.label: Known trims and CP4 cap reductions
record.summary: Known arithmetic trims remain insufficient, and the two direct CP4 cap descendants are now measured. Cap1024 saves 81,756,130,304 FLOPs per call but produces pooled unique-fixture final drift 9.999932286193823e-6. Cap1792 saves 20,399,602,944 FLOPs per call but still produces pooled unique drift 2.503792400835152e-6. Both fail their frozen accuracy gates.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed only for the enumerated incremental trims; any successor must present an exact additional static/literal cost delta and its raw-accuracy consequence.
